title: Hachiko Memorial Statue & Scramble
address: 東京都渋谷区道玄坂2-1
description: Tokyo's iconic meeting landmark commemorating the faithful Akita dog. Adjacent to the world's busiest pedestrian scramble crossing.
photoTip: Best shot at dusk or rainy nights using Shibuya Crossing reflection puddles with shutter priority 1/15s.
taxiPhrase: 渋谷駅のハチ公口までお願いします (Shibuya-eki no Hachiko-guchi made onegaishimasu)

title: Ichiran Shibuya — Solo Ramen Booths
address: 東京都渋谷区神南1-22-7 岩本ビルB1F
addressEn: B1F Iwamoto Bldg, 1-22-7 Jinnan, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
description: Pioneering private solo-dining booth system (Yatai-flavor). Customize noodle firmness, rich dashi tonkotsu broth, and red secret sauce without speaking.
photoTip: Shoot the private wooden counter cubicle and bamboo curtain reveal when your piping hot bowl arrives.
taxiPhrase: 渋谷の神南一丁目の一蘭までお願いします (Shibuya Jinnan 1-chome no Ichiran made onegaishimasu)
soloDineTip: Fill out paper order slip (English available). Press call button once. Zero spoken words necessary.

title: Shibuya Sky 360° Rooftop Deck
address: 東京都渋谷区渋谷2-24-12 渋谷スクランブルスクエア45F
description: 229-meter high open-air observation roof overlooking Shibuya Crossing, Shinjuku towers, and Mount Fuji during clear golden hour sunsets.
photoTip: Book 17:30 slot 4 weeks in advance for Twilight Golden Hour. All loose bags must be locked in lockers; phone only.
taxiPhrase: 渋谷スクランブルスクエアまでお願いします (Shibuya Sukuranburu Sukuea made onegaishimasu)

title: Chicago Thrift & Vintage
titleJa: 原宿シカゴ 神宮前店
address: 東京都渋谷区神宮前4-26-26
description: Massive curated basement thrifting mecca stocked with authentic Japanese silk kimonos, 90s vintage sukajan souvenir bomber jackets, and reworked streetwear.
photoTip: Rows of neon-lit patterned haori jackets create a rich chromatic background for detail shots.
taxiPhrase: 神宮前四丁目のシカゴ古着屋までお願いします (Jingumae 4-chome no Shikago furugiya made onegaishimasu)
soloDineTip: Foreign passport tax exemption available for purchases exceeding ¥5,000 before tax.

title: Meiji Jingu Forest Shrine
address: 東京都渋谷区代々木神園町1-1
description: Serene 170-acre evergreen forest planted by volunteers in 1920. Giant cedar torii gate and historic sake barrel wall (Kazaridaru).
photoTip: Visit at 07:00 AM before crowds arrive. The morning mist through the wooden Torii gate is breathtaking.
taxiPhrase: 明治神宮の原宿口までお願いします (Meiji Jingu no Harajuku-guchi made onegaishimasu)

title: New York Joe Exchange Thrifting
titleJa: ニューヨークジョー エクスチェンジ下北沢
address: 東京都世田谷区北沢3-26-4
description: Housed inside a converted 1960s Japanese bathhouse (Sento). Retains vintage tiled wall details with hand-picked 80s/90s Japanese streetwear.
photoTip: Look for the remaining bathhouse water faucets and retro tile architecture inside the fitting rooms.
subwayLine: Keio Inokashira Line (Express from Shibuya in 4m)
taxiPhrase: 下北沢の北沢三丁目までお願いします (Shimokitazawa no Kitazawa 3-chome made onegaishimasu)

title: Fuunji Smoky Tsukemen
address: 東京都渋谷区代々木2-14-3 北斗第一ビル1F
addressEn: 1F Hokuto Daiichi Bldg, 2-14-3 Yoyogi, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
description: Legendary dipping noodles featuring velvety chicken-and-fish broth topped with fragrant fish powder (gyofun) and thick springy noodles.
photoTip: Counter chefs move with kinetic balletic precision; capture the steam rising from the broth bowl.
taxiPhrase: 南新宿の風雲児までお願いします (Minami-Shinjuku no Fuunji made onegaishimasu)
soloDineTip: Buy ticket from machine inside entrance. Hand ticket to server when queueing behind seated patrons.

title: Shinjuku Golden Gai Alleyways
address: 東京都新宿区歌舞伎町1-1-6
description: Six narrow passageways jammed with over 200 tiny 4-seat micro-bars preserved from post-war Tokyo. Intimate conversation with bartenders.
photoTip: Look for 'English Menu / No Table Charge' neon signs before stepping into stairwells.
taxiPhrase: 新宿ゴールデン街の花園神社側までお願いします (Shinjuku Goruden-gai no Hanazono Jinja gawa made onegaishimasu)

title: teamLab Planets TOKYO Immersive
titleJa: チームラボプラネッツ TOKYO DMM
address: 東京都江東区豊洲6-1-16
description: Sensory body-immersive museum where you walk barefoot through water filled with swimming digital koi carp and the infinite Crystal Universe.
photoTip: Wear shorts or rollable pants (water is knee-deep). Mirrors cover floors—wear shorts under skirts.
taxiPhrase: 新豊洲のチームラボプラネッツまでお願いします (Shin-Toyosu no Chimu Rabo Puranetsu made onegaishimasu)

title: Radio Kaikan Retro Tech & Hobby Hub
address: 東京都千代田区外神田1-15-16
description: 10 floors of Japanese pop culture, retro gaming, electronic components, vintage anime figurines, and blind-box gachapon machines.
photoTip: Level 4 K-Books and Level 2 Kaiyodo displays offer macro-lens photography of miniature sculptures.
subwayLine: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line (H16) / JR Yamanote
taxiPhrase: 秋葉原駅の電気街口、ラジオ会館までお願いします (Akihabara-eki no Denki-gai-guchi, Rajio Kaikan made onegaishimasu)

title: Standing Sushi Bar Uogashi Nihon-Ichi
titleJa: 立ち喰い寿司 魚がし日本一 銀座
address: 東京都中央区銀座3-2-12
description: Authentic Edomae nigiri served fast on bamboo leaves directly in front of the itamae chef. High-grade otoro, salmon, and unagi at convenience store prices.
photoTip: Chef torches seared salmon belly (Aburi salmon) with culinary blowtorch right in front of you.
taxiPhrase: 銀座三丁目の魚がし日本一までお願いします (Ginza 3-chome no Uogashi Nihon-Ichi made onegaishimasu)
soloDineTip: Stand at open counter slot, order 2 pieces per round. Dip fish-side down into soy saucer.

title: Senso-ji Temple & Kaminarimon
address: 東京都台東区浅草2-3-1
description: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple founded in 645 AD. The giant red paper chochin lantern weighs 700 kg under the Thunder Gate.
photoTip: Visit at 20:30 at night! The crowds vanish, and the pagoda is illuminated in vivid vermilion against black sky.
taxiPhrase: 浅草寺の雷門までお願いします (Senso-ji no Kaminarimon made onegaishimasu)

title: Fushimi Inari Taisha Thousand Torii
titleJa: 伏見稲荷大社 千本鳥居
address: 京都府京都市伏見区深草藪之内町68
nearestStation: JR Inari Station (JR Nara Line) / Fushimi-Inari (Keihan)
description: Spiritual mountain path embraced by over 10,000 vivid vermilion torii gates dedicated to Inari, the Shinto deity of harvest and commerce.
photoTip: Hike past Yotsutsuji intersection (30 mins uphill) to the upper mountain loops for completely deserted torii tunnel shots.
subwayLine: JR Nara Line (5m direct from Kyoto Stn)
taxiPhrase: 伏見稲荷大社の正面口までお願いします (Fushimi Inari Taisha no shomen-guchi made onegaishimasu)

title: Kiyomizu-dera & Yasaka Pagoda Vista
address: 京都府京都市東山区清水1-294
description: UNESCO World Heritage temple with wooden stage built without a single nail overlooking a sea of cherry blossoms and Kyoto city below.
photoTip: Walk down Yasaka-dori at 06:15 AM to photograph the 5-story Yasaka Pagoda framed by traditional machiya wooden townhouses.
taxiPhrase: 東山の五条坂・清水寺までお願いします (Higashiyama no Gojozaka, Kiyomizu-dera made onegaishimasu)

title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & % Arabica
titleJa: 嵐山竹林の小径・アラビカ京都嵐山
address: 京都府京都市右京区嵯峨小倉山田淵山町
description: Towering natural green bamboo cathedral that whispers in the mountain breeze. Sip craft single-origin espresso along the Oi River bank.
photoTip: Arrive at 07:00 AM on the Keifuku Electric Tram. Light rays filter through bamboo stalks creating heavenly god-rays.
subwayLine: JR San-in Main (Sagano) Line (16m from Kyoto Stn)
taxiPhrase: 嵐山の渡月橋北詰、竹林までお願いします (Arashiyama no Togetsukyo Kita-zume, Chikurin made onegaishimasu)

title: Gion Duck Noodles Hidden Gem
address: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側329 祇園ファーストビル1F
addressEn: 1F Gion First Bldg, 329 Gionmachi Kitagawa, Higashiyama, Kyoto
description: Ultra-stealth culinary speakeasy tucked in an alley with only duck and ramen emojis on the door. French-technique smoked duck ramen with sansho pepper.
photoTip: The menu is entirely printed in emojis: 🦆+🍜 = duck ramen; 🦆+🍊 = duck ramen with orange reduction.
taxiPhrase: 祇園四条の八坂神社近くまでお願いします (Gion Shijo no Yasaka Jinja chikaku made onegaishimasu)
soloDineTip: Solo counter seating only with individual brass chopsticks rest and tea dispenser.

title: The Motokichi Fluffy Omurice
titleJa: ザ・洋食屋 キチキチ
address: 京都府京都市中京区材木町185-1
description: Celebrity Chef Motokichi slices open a pillow-soft tornado omelet that blankets fried rice in molten egg velvet topped with red wine demi-glace.
photoTip: Ready your phone in slow-motion video (120fps) when chef counts 'San, Ni, Ichi!' to slice the omelet.
taxiPhrase: 木屋町のキチキチオムライスまでお願いします (Kiyamachi no Kichikichi Omuraisu made onegaishimasu)

title: Dotonbori Canal & Glico Running Man
titleJa: 道頓堀 グリコサイン・戎橋
address: 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-4
openingHours: Open 24 Hours (Neon lights up at sunset until 24:00)
description: The neon heart of Osaka's culinary soul along the Dotonbori canal. Home to giant moving mechanical crabs, blowfish lanterns, and street vendors.
photoTip: Stand on Ebisubashi Bridge or take the Tombori River Cruise for low-angle wide shots of the 140,000 LED Glico runner.
taxiPhrase: 難波の道頓堀、戎橋までお願いします (Namba no Dotonbori, Ebisubashi made onegaishimasu)

title: Kukuru Giant Octopus Takoyaki
titleJa: たこ家道頓堀くくる 本店
address: 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-5 白亜ビル1F
description: Molten interior octopus dough balls with giant octopus tentacles bursting outside, brushed with sweet umami sauce, kewpie mayo, and dancing bonito flakes.
photoTip: Grab a hot box of 8, lean on the canal railing, and watch the dancing katsuobushi flakes against neon water reflections.
taxiPhrase: 道頓堀の大きなたこ看板のくくるまでお願いします (Dotonbori no okina tako-kamban no Kukuru made onegaishimasu)
soloDineTip: Eat fresh and scorching hot—pierce the center with toothpick first to let steam escape!

title: Retro Shinsekai & Tsutenkaku Tower
address: 大阪府大阪市浪速区恵美須東1-18-6
description: Time-capsule 1912 entertainment neighborhood inspired by Paris and Coney Island. Towering retro neon signage and Billiken good-luck deity statues.
photoTip: Position yourself at the South Alley perspective where giant blowfish lantern and neon kanji banners frame the Tsutenkaku tower.
taxiPhrase: 新世界の通天閣下までお願いします (Shinsekai no Tsutenkaku-shita made onegaishimasu)

title: Yaekatsu Golden Skewers (Kushikatsu)
address: 大阪府大阪市浪速区恵美須東3-4-13 ジャンジャン横丁
description: Crisp panko-crusted beef, lotus root, boiled egg, and cheese skewers fried golden in light beef tallow. Crisp cabbage wedges served as palate cleanser.
photoTip: The retro U-shaped wooden bar with master fry cooks dropping skewers into boiling copper cauldrons.
taxiPhrase: ジャンジャン横丁の八重勝までお願いします (Janjan Yokocho no Yaekatsu made onegaishimasu)
soloDineTip: Golden Rule of Osaka: 'Nido-zuke Kinshi' (Strictly no double-dipping in shared sauce vat!). Use raw cabbage to scoop extra sauce.

title: Umeda Sky Building Floating Garden
titleJa: 梅田スカイビル 空中庭園展望台
address: 大阪府大阪市北区大淀中1-1-88
description: Futuristic twin 40-story skyscrapers bridged at the top by a donut-shaped open-air observatory. Glass escalator rides suspended in mid-air.
photoTip: Walk the 'Lumi Sky Walk' rooftop pathway at night; phosphorescent stone pavement glows like the Milky Way beneath your feet.
subwayLine: JR Tokaido Line / Osaka Loop Line
taxiPhrase: 梅田スカイビルの空中庭園までお願いします (Umeda Sukai Biru no Kuchu Teien made onegaishimasu)
